description: This Perl script manipulates binary chunk files, performing tasks like reading a chunk, handling file offsets, and packing/unpacking 64-bit values in a format that supports files of arbitrary size. It seems to be part of a tool for editing or processing chunk-based binary files, possibly for data recovery or file repair.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from STDIN with error handling.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Reads bytes using get() and then outputs them, effectively copying data chunks.

methods.name: unpack_quad
methods.description: Unpacks 8 bytes into a 64-bit integer, faking 64-bit support on platforms without native 64-bit integer support.

methods.name: pack_quad
methods.description: Packs a 32-bit integer into a 8-byte binary string representing a 64-bit value, ensuring it fits within 32 bits.
